changes: Extended only the existing SAS end bounds: Compustat annual/quarterly records, daily FX, and December CRSP market-cap formation data now include 2006; MSF, MSEDELIST, and MSIX monthly inputs now include returns through 2008-04-30. The pooled reconstruction retains the original period start, sources, screens, units, transformations, four-year history, lag/lead rules, and return definitions.

Kept the accepted annual OLS and asreg Fama–MacBeth Newey–West lag-1 estimator. Updated the annual fit check to 28 years, recalculated the separate Bernard finite-sample factor over the observed annual coefficient series, and counted original/added observations from active e(sample)s. The native marker records 3,781 original-period and 1,273 added-period observations, last added year 2006.

The current pooled build contains 22,965 low-BM firm-years and 5,054 Table 7 complete cases. Added-year complete-case counts are 144 (2002), 420 (2003), 243 (2004), 230 (2005), and 236 (2006). All 28 annual fits are rank 7 with positive residual degrees of freedom; annual N ranges from 77 to 420.

The longer construction window reports 0 annual duplicate keys, 486 GVKEY/fiscal-quarter duplicate keys, and 848 same-date tie keys (1,696 rows) after the fiscal-quarter exclusions; existing ambiguity exclusions were retained. FX duplicate keys, primary-link mapping ambiguities, return duplicate months, delisting duplicate months, and final GVKEY/year duplicate keys are all 0.
limitations: The paper leaves the underlying estimator and precise autocorrelation correction underdescribed. The reconstruction uses annual OLS and asreg Fama–MacBeth Newey–West lag 1 for main coefficient p-values; this is not Bernard (1995). The separate GSCORE statistic uses the printed AR(1) finite-sample factor with Pearson lag-one correlation over 27 adjacent annual coefficient pairs (n=28).
Table 7-specific raw BM and raw MOM definitions follow its note despite conflicting §4.4 log-BM and size-adjusted-MOM prose.

The current Compustat/CRSP vintage, source-field coverage, quarterly same-date ambiguity exclusions, historical SIC-source overlap, exact-date FX availability, common-share company aggregation, and December size-decile assignment affect sample size. Source coverage supports the requested endpoint, but these construction/data limits remain.
Quarterly XAD is absent in FUNDQ. The accepted build uses the latest same-currency annual XAD record available by the selected quarterly date and leaves missing amounts missing.

The paper’s pre-1988 CFO footnote does not state the WCAPC sign conversion by SCF format or specify early-adopter SCF 7 use of direct OANCF. The codebook sign mapping and SCF 7 direct-measurement exception remain documented assumptions.

Table 2 default-zero language could be broader than the explicit G4/G5 missing-history rule. The construction leaves unavailable current R&D, capex, and advertising inputs missing, so GSCORE completeness may differ.
The paper does not detail portfolio decile breakpoint methodology. Annual primary-security size ranks are matched to the source-native CRSP MSIX decile return series.

The current original-period rebuild differs from the saved accepted attempt_02 by one firm-year in formation year 2001: current low-BM count 927 vs 928 previously, and complete-case count 239 vs 240. The original-period complete-case totals are 3,781 in this pooled rebuild and 3,782 in the saved run. The exact source/construction reason is unresolved; this difference is not attributed to vintage. The 2002–2006 fit still contributes 1,273 complete observations.

The original-period low-BM sample remains materially below the paper’s reported 21,724 firm-years and its 21,253 Table 7 complete observations; the accepted attempt_02 had 18,509 low-BM firm-years and 3,782 complete observations, versus 18,508 and 3,781 in the pooled rebuild’s original window. The extended 28-year total of 5,054 is not a like-for-like comparison with the paper’s 23-year total.

analyses.label: Table 7, column (2): annual SRET1 regression with GSCORE and full controls
analyses.reason: The pooled current-vintage reconstruction produced full-rank annual fits for every formation year from 1979 through 2006. The native controller log verifies 3,781 original-period and 1,273 added-period firm-year observations in the annual OLS e(samples), with 2006 as the last contributing formation year. Bounded coverage checks establish the required 2006 accounting/market inputs and the 2007-05 through 2008-04 return windows.

analyses.count_unit: Firm-year observations summed over the annual OLS first-stage e(samples); the Fama–MacBeth second stage averages 28 annual coefficient observations.
analyses.comparison: The saved accepted Table 7 column (2) table at output/reproductions/packages/W3124580969/attempt_02/tables/table7_col2_fmb.md reports GSCORE b=0.013 and Newey–West Fama–MacBeth p=0.124, with separate Bernard-adjusted t=1.57. The fresh pooled result at work/tables/table7_col2_fmb.md reports GSCORE b=0.012, p=0.115, and separate Bernard-adjusted t=1.64. Both coefficients are decimal SRET1 return per one GSCORE point; p-values and t-statistics are dimensionless and table coefficients are rounded to three decimals. The saved original fit had N=3,782; the pooled current rebuild has 3,781 observations from 1979–2001 plus 1,273 from 2002–2006. Its 2001 low-BM count is one lower than the accepted run (927 vs 928), with the exact source/construction reason unresolved. Table 7 itself reports GSCORE b=0.034 and autocorrelation-adjusted t=5.53 (printed p. 158).
